content_sections.heading: AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The AEES online application portal opens on 2 November 2026. Candidates should complete registration, application submission and fee payment before the deadline.

rows.date: Within 72 Hours of Answer Key Display

content_sections.heading: AEES Teacher Vacancy 2026 - Post-Wise Details
content_sections.text: The Atomic Energy Education Society Recruitment 2026 offers 254 tentative vacancies across teaching, school administration and library positions. The largest number of vacancies is for Primary Teacher (PRT) and Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT) posts. Note: The vacancies are tentative and may increase or decrease according to AEES requirements. There are 27 Post Graduate Teacher vacancies under AEES PGT Recruitment 2026. These vacancies are distributed across nine subjects. AEES has announced 102 TGT vacancies for English, Mathematics-Physics, Social Studies, Computer Science, Science, languages and other subjects. The AEES PRT Vacancy 2026 includes 89 Primary Teacher posts. Candidates must possess the prescribed elementary education qualification and qualify CTET Paper I. The maximum age limit is 30 years, subject to applicable relaxation. AEES has also advertised 10 Primary Teacher (Music) vacancies. The Music Teacher post requires a relevant bachelor's degree in Music or Performing Arts along with the prescribed Class 12 qualification. A diploma in Music alone does not meet the notified requirement. Under AEES Librarian Recruitment 2026 , 13 vacancies have been announced. Candidates must hold a Bachelor's Degree in Library Science or Library and Information Science with at least 50% marks and possess knowledge of computer applications. The maximum age is 35 years, and the pay scale is Rs. 44,900 to Rs. 1,42,400 under Level 7. PwBD reservations are applied horizontally within the advertised vacancies and are not additional posts.

content_sections.heading: AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026 Eligibility and Qualification
content_sections.text: The educational qualifications vary by post. Candidates applying for AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026 should check the required academic qualifications, teaching degrees, CTET eligibility and experience specified in Recruitment Notification 01/2026. Important: The above table is a qualification summary. Candidates must verify the exact minimum marks, permitted qualification combinations, subject requirements and experience criteria for the selected post in the official notification. Yes. CTET Paper I is mandatory for the regular Primary Teacher (PRT) posts. Candidates must also meet one of the following qualification combinations: Class 12 with at least 50% marks and a two-year Diploma in Elementary Education; or Class 12 with at least 50% marks and a four-year Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.); or Class 12 with at least 50% marks and a two-year Diploma in Education (Special Education) from RCI. Applicants should check the additional conditions for special education qualifications in the notification. AEES has advertised Computer Science teaching vacancies at both PGT and TGT levels. For PGT Computer Science, the prescribed qualifications include relevant postgraduate computing qualifications and an accepted teaching qualification. For TGT Computer Science, the notification accepts specified undergraduate Computer Science / IT qualifications or equivalent routes with B.Ed.

content_sections.heading: AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026 age limit depends on the post. The maximum age ranges from 30 years for Primary Teacher and Balvatika Teacher posts to 50 years for Principal. Other age concessions apply to eligible AEES employees, government servants and ex-servicemen according to the official notification. Where multiple concessions apply, only the highest permissible relaxation is granted under the notification's rules.

rows.upper_age_relaxation: 10 Years for Specified Teaching and Librarian Posts

content_sections.heading: AEES Teacher Salary 2026 - PRT, TGT, PGT Pay Scale
content_sections.text: The AEES Teacher Salary 2026 depends on the post and pay level under the applicable pay matrix. The starting basic pay ranges from Rs. 35,400 for PRT and Balvatika Teacher posts to Rs. 78,800 for Principal. The starting basic pay for AEES Primary Teachers is Rs. 35,400 per month under Pay Level 6. The pay matrix extends up to Rs. 1,12,400. Actual gross salary and take-home salary will depend on applicable allowances and deductions. AEES TGT teachers receive a pay scale of Rs. 44,900 to Rs. 1,42,400 under Pay Level 7. The starting basic pay is Rs. 44,900 per month. The AEES PGT pay scale is Rs. 47,600 to Rs. 1,51,100 under Pay Level 8. The starting basic pay is Rs. 47,600 per month, excluding applicable allowances.

content_sections.heading: AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The AEES Recruitment 2026 application fee consists of an application fee and a processing fee. The fee amount depends on the candidate's category. Note: Applicable GST is charged additionally by the bank. Payment must be made online through the prescribed payment gateway. Candidates applying for different permitted posts must pay the required fee separately for each post.

content_sections.heading: AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by an interview or skill test, as applicable to the post. Computer Based Test (CBT) Interview or Skill Test, depending on the post Document Verification Other prescribed appointment formalities For Principal and Vice-Principal posts, selection includes CBT and interview. For other notified posts, AEES applies the relevant CBT merit, skill test or interview requirements specified in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026 Syllabus and Exam Pattern
content_sections.text: The AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026 syllabus covers general knowledge, reasoning, language ability, computer knowledge, teaching methodology and subject-related knowledge. The examination pattern differs between school leadership posts and other teaching posts. AEES Teacher Syllabus 2026 Exam Duration: 2 Hours Negative Marking: No negative marking The CBT for Principal and Vice-Principal posts comprises 150 questions for 150 marks with a duration of 2 hours and 30 minutes . There is no negative marking. The syllabus includes General English, General Hindi, Reasoning, General Knowledge, Basic Computer Literacy, Numerical Ability, Teaching and Learning, School Organization, Leadership, Management, Administration and Finance. Candidates can access the detailed post-wise AEES syllabus through the official AEES application portal .

content_sections.heading: AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can submit the AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026 application form online through the official recruitment portal. Applications are accepted from 2 November 2026 at 10:00 AM until 22 November 2026 at 11:50 PM. Apply Online: AEES Recruitment 2026 Online Application Portal Important: Candidates may apply for more than one permitted post by paying the respective fees separately. However, applicants can select only one subject within the PGT category and only one subject within the TGT category.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official AEES application portal at aees.onlineregistrationforms.com . Read AEES Recruitment Notification 01/2026 carefully. Register using your personal email ID and mobile number. Log in and select the eligible post and subject. Enter the required personal, educational and other application details. Upload the prescribed photograph, certificates and documents as instructed. Check the category-wise application fee and processing fee. Pay the required fee through the online payment gateway. Review all entered details and complete application submission. Download and print the confirmation page for future reference. Note: AEES states that an application without a generated confirmation page will be treated as incomplete. Candidates do not need to send a printed application to AEES by post.

content_sections.heading: AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Atomic Energy Education Society has published Recruitment Notification 01/2026 for 254 teaching and related vacancies. The detailed notification contains post-wise vacancies, qualifications, pay scales, age relaxation, examination scheme, selection rules, fees and application guidelines. Candidates should download the official notification and check the applicable annexures before applying online. Official Notification PDF: Download AEES Recruitment Notification 01/2026

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Atomic Energy Education Society has announced 254 vacancies for PGT, TGT, PRT, Librarian, Principal, Vice-Principal, PRT Music and Balvatika Teacher posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 22 November 2026 at 11:50 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the AEES teacher salary per month?
faq.answer: The starting basic pay ranges from Rs. 35,400 for PRT posts to Rs. 78,800 for Principal posts. Actual monthly salary depends on the post, allowances and deductions.

faq.question: Q4. How many AEES PRT vacancies are available in 2026?
faq.answer: There are 89 regular PRT vacancies and 10 additional PRT Music vacancies.

faq.question: Q5. How many AEES TGT vacancies are available?
faq.answer: AEES has announced 102 TGT vacancies across various subjects, including English, Mathematics-Physics, Chemistry-Biology, Computer Science and Social Studies.

faq.question: Q6. How many AEES PGT vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are 27 PGT vacancies across nine notified subjects.

faq.question: Q7. What is the eligibility for AEES PRT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates need the prescribed Class 12 qualification, an accepted elementary education qualification and CTET Paper I.

faq.question: Q8. Is CTET compulsory for AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: CTET is required for regular PRT and specified TGT posts. The notification provides exceptions for certain subject categories, including Computer Science, Music, Art Education and Physical Education.

faq.question: Q9. What is the AEES Recruitment 2026 application fee?
faq.answer: General, OBC and EWS candidates must pay Rs. 1,000 before GST, while women, SC, ST, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen candidates must pay the Rs. 250 processing fee before GST.

faq.question: Q10. What is the AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026 exam pattern?
faq.answer: The CBT for PGT, TGT, PRT, Librarian and related teaching posts contains 120 questions for 120 marks with a duration of two hours. There is no negative marking.
